# Data of web-platform-tests

The files `urltestdata.json`, `urltestdata-javascript-only.json`,
`setters_tests.json`, `toascii.json`, `IdnaTestV2.json`,
`IdnaTestV2-removed.json` and `percent-encoding.json` are copied unchanged from
`url/resources/` of github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt, at commit
`8af128e89e4d51dd18298361058d3616bbe81afc` (2026-11-12). The license is the
3-Clause BSD License of the project, in [WPT-LICENSE.md](WPT-LICENSE.md).

`known-failures.txt` is ours: the cases the parser does not pass, each with its
reason.
